generated_under: BI Token Optimization Program, Phase 5A (Offline Request Profiling & Token Budgeting)
methodology: baseline_static_bytes are measured, not aspirational -- current byte size of the STATIC fields listed for each entry, taken directly from live module-level constants (SYSTEM prompts, schema text, fixed instructions).

Only the static_fields listed per entry are gated. Every other request component (source_document, procurement_context, buyer_intelligence, proposal_content, and analyst.py's per-call dynamic user prompt) is intentionally NOT gated here, because real RFP/proposal size legitimately varies -- gating it would either block legitimate large documents or require an arbitrary aspirational cap this phase was told not to invent.

warning_threshold_bytes = baseline * 1.20 (rounded up); hard_regression_threshold_bytes = baseline * 1.50 (rounded up). A static field should almost never grow -- these are wide enough to tolerate a genuine small wording edit while still catching runaway bloat (e.g. an accidentally-duplicated block, a schema pasted in twice).

provider_counted_input_tokens is never used for these budgets -- client.messages.count_tokens() was attempted once during this baseline run and failed with the same 'credit balance too low' error as messages.create (see docs/current/SYSTEM_STATE.md / Phase 5 commissioning history), so every number below is an exact character/byte measurement, never an estimated or provider-reported token count.

informational_total_request_bytes is the full representative-request size (static + synthetic dynamic content) from the same profiling run, included for context only -- it is not a budget and must not be asserted against in regression tests.

budgets.source: section_analyzer._ANALYZER_SYSTEM + the fixed instructions_block returned by _analyzer_prompt(return_components=True)

fast_analysis._ROUTE_SCHEMAS[ROUTE_EVAL_ONLY] + the fixed header text in _build_prompt() (measured for one representative route; other routes have their own schema constants, not individually budgeted this pass)
stage_d_projection.SYNTHESIS_PROMPT (module constant; the remaining request_text is the dynamic canonical_json(projection) context, intentionally unbudgeted)
